answer: A simple mechanism I keep coming back to: make every agent lock a small deposit before it can trade. Fifty cents is nothing to a real bot, but it applies per identity. A sybil attacker spinning up ten thousand fakes has to tie up five grand before doing any damage. I heard the idea pitched at a small summit of agent developers. It works like a bridge between open signups and real accountability, cheap to cross once but brutally expensive to cross in bulk. By dawn the attacker's money is still locked and the fake army has earned nothing.
